text: Draycott Drive is a local road located in the Victoria Village neighbourhood of Ward 16. The speed limit on Draycott is 50 kilometres per hour to 40 kilometres per hour throughout most of the surrounding local roads. In an effort to reduce speeding on Draycott and to bring a consistent speed limit through the neighbourhood, I am making the following recommendations.
North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 kilometres per hour to 40 kilometres per hour on Draycott Drive, between Sloane Avenue and Victoria Park Avenue.
